tooltip.specialpickaxes.controls: R: use / analyze / confirm / pause / resume / cancel domains · X: technique / cancel a selection or excavation · C: mode · I: manual
message.specialpickaxes.no_target: No valid operation: check target, memory, anchors or material.
message.specialpickaxes.alternate_no_tar: No valid target; no durability or cooldown was consumed.
message.specialpickaxes.anchor_a: First anchor marked. Activate at the destination.
message.specialpickaxes.linked: Link active. Mining near A echoes at B.
tooltip.specialpickaxes.palimpsest: Harvests matching connected ores, including diagonal and deepslate variants. Passive: Haste II and Regeneration I while held or in Curios.
tooltip.specialpickaxes.secondary.palimp: Aim at an exposed ore and activate to harvest its same-family vein, including diagonal neighbors. The server sets the block cap.
tooltip.specialpickaxes.fault_choir: Drills a safe 2×2 resonant tunnel 20 blocks forward in the direction you face.
tooltip.specialpickaxes.secondary.fault_: X sends a ground-borne pulse that checks the momentum of up to four nearby grounded hostiles; it does not dig a second tunnel.
tooltip.specialpickaxes.eventide: Anchor a gravity field. Mining four consecutive matching stone blocks fractures up to six of that block ahead. Haste III inside.
tooltip.specialpickaxes.secondary.eventi: Aim at stone and activate to anchor the field. Mode sets inward/outward priority; cancel releases it.
tooltip.specialpickaxes.meridian: Link two loaded anchors in one dimension. Mining near the first echoes at the second.
tooltip.specialpickaxes.secondary.meridi: Use on A, then B. Mine near A; work echoes at B. Sneak-use: unlink.
tooltip.specialpickaxes.paradox_crucible: Select two corners and transmute only natural geology. Mode cycles the output block; player-placed blocks, ores, containers and fluids are preserved.
tooltip.specialpickaxes.secondary.parado: Cycle Stone, Deepslate, Granite, Diorite, Andesite, Dirt, Basalt, Obsidian, Calcite, Tuff, Dripstone and Gravel. Select corners, analyze, and confirm.
tooltip.specialpickaxes.interregnum: Anchor a marked 16×16 Stasis domain: ×8 mining speed, Regeneration V, Absorption IV, Resistance II, food restoration, and Night Vision. Switch to a personal aura.
tooltip.specialpickaxes.secondary.interr: Use: anchor the domain or toggle your personal aura. Mode: Domain/Aura. Cancel: release Stasis.
tooltip.specialpickaxes.worldloom: R opens a 3×3 branching Rootwake tunnel up to 24 blocks through natural geology; ores and placed blocks stay safe.
tooltip.specialpickaxes.secondary.worldl: X roots up to 16 hostile or PvP-valid targets within 10 blocks for 2.5 seconds. No aiming required.
tooltip.specialpickaxes.icarus: R bores forward through safe slices. X clears a vertical shaft and lifts you toward the surface.
tooltip.specialpickaxes.secondary.icarus: X opens a one-block-wide, two-block-high shaft and carries you upward to the surface, up to 384 blocks. Barriers stop the lift.
tooltip.specialpickaxes.hollow_axiom: R mines the outer shell of a marked natural-stone sphere and leaves its core intact.
tooltip.specialpickaxes.secondary.hollow: X sends an 8-block Nullwave: repels, lifts, slows and marks nearby enemies, and deflects hostile projectiles while you mine.
tooltip.specialpickaxes.bifold_atlas: Exchange two selected volumes with mirror or rotation; conserves matter without item loot.
tooltip.specialpickaxes.secondary.bifold: Use: arm four corners. Sneak-left: transform. Analyze, then confirm.
tooltip.specialpickaxes.worldbreaker: Excavates according to the selected mode: CARVE, FRACTURE, CLEAVE, CORE DRILL, WORLD SHATTER, or REGION BREAK. CORE DRILL prevents fall damage while it runs.
tooltip.specialpickaxes.secondary.worldb: Sneak-use cycles five directional cuts and REGION BREAK. The regional mode selects two corners, analyzes, then mines only harvestable blocks; fluids, bedrock, and containers stay intact.
tooltip.specialpickaxes.chronicle: Record a geological checkpoint; restore missing cells later with real materials.
tooltip.specialpickaxes.secondary.chroni: Use: arm two corners. Sneak-use when idle: record/restore.
tooltip.specialpickaxes.keystone: Raise an oriented 9-wide, 5-deep parabolic vault from the aimed base, using inventory blocks.
tooltip.specialpickaxes.secondary.keysto: Aim at the base and Use: build the vault. Offhand: material. Sneak-use: supports.
tooltip.specialpickaxes.tessellator: Reproduce an existing geological blueprint in another region, paying for every placed block.
tooltip.specialpickaxes.secondary.tessel: Use: arm source and target corners. Sneak-left: mirror/rotate.
tooltip.specialpickaxes.aegis: Redirect incoming hostile projectiles without changing their ownership.
tooltip.specialpickaxes.secondary.aegis: Aim and Use: redirect projectiles; Use again: stop. Sneak-use: reflect/shear.
tooltip.specialpickaxes.lodestar: Retrace remembered footsteps through still-clear loaded space.
tooltip.specialpickaxes.secondary.lodest: Use: mark your route. Walk; Use again: retrace and consume the route. Sneak-use: forget.
tooltip.specialpickaxes.seam_ripper: Peels a connected material contact seam. C changes from A/B contact to exposed A surfaces.
tooltip.specialpickaxes.secondary.seam_r: X peels the connected B-side seam touching targeted A. Put B in your offhand.
tooltip.specialpickaxes.causeway: Paid footing follows your route over gaps; it does not grant flight.
tooltip.specialpickaxes.secondary.causew: Use: start/stop automatic footing. Carry plain offhand material. Sneak-use stops.
tooltip.specialpickaxes.counterseal: Protect nearby terrain from explosions, not entities from damage.
tooltip.specialpickaxes.secondary.counte: Use: start/stop the moving terrain ward. Sneak-use stops. Entity damage remains.
tooltip.specialpickaxes.covenant: Seal confirmed manual mining scars after you pass them, using inventory material.
tooltip.specialpickaxes.secondary.covena: Use: start/stop sealing. Mine manually and move past holes. Offhand: filling material.
ux.specialpickaxes.intro_region: Relic: Use arms; left clicks select; press R to analyze and confirm when ready. Details in the tooltip.
ux.specialpickaxes.cost.paid: One plain inventory block per placement. Activation wear: %s.
ux.specialpickaxes.cost.matter: Conserves matter; no generated loot. Activation wear: %s.
ux.specialpickaxes.cost.mining: Activation wear: %s; mining also uses normal durability.
message.specialpickaxes.volume_limit: Selection too large. Reduce its size.
message.specialpickaxes.overlap: INVALID · Source and target overlap. No operation queued.
message.specialpickaxes.incompatible: Incompatible dimensions: %s -> %s. A 90° turn swaps width and depth.
message.specialpickaxes.backpressure: Queue full. Wait for another operation to finish.
ux.specialpickaxes.region_controls: Press R to arm selection. Left click two corners. Press R to analyze and press R at READY to execute. C changes the mode before selection.
ux.specialpickaxes.cancel_help: While working: press R to pause/resume; sneak-use cancels. Switching tools cancels work.
ux.specialpickaxes.resources: Paid construction/restore: plain inventory blocks. No recipes. No unloaded chunks or machines.
message.specialpickaxes.armed: Select corners with left click. Cancel exits.
message.specialpickaxes.corner: Corner %s selected. Continue with left click.
message.specialpickaxes.selection_invali: INVALID · Check size, transform dimensions, overlap, range and permissions.
message.specialpickaxes.need_corners: Corners %s / %s · Left click selects the next corner.
message.specialpickaxes.chunk_pause: Paused: next chunk is unloaded. Load the area, then press Pause/resume.
status.specialpickaxes.anchor_b: Anchor A marked · activate at B
identity.specialpickaxes.palimpsest: Repair the scars you left behind.
controls.specialpickaxes.palimpsest: Aim at a scar and Use: restore nearby memories. No corners.
example.specialpickaxes.palimpsest: Example: Repair a tunnel wall using actual stone.
controls.specialpickaxes.fault_choir: Aim and Use: replay. Sneak-use: rotate 90 degrees.
example.specialpickaxes.fault_choir: Example: Repeat a staircase in another matching wall.
controls.specialpickaxes.eventide: Aim and Use: anchor the field and quarry. Sneak-use: polarity, or cancel active work.
example.specialpickaxes.eventide: Example: Clear a fighting space and divert hostile shots.
controls.specialpickaxes.meridian: Use on A, then B. Mine near A; work echoes at B. Sneak-use: unlink.
example.specialpickaxes.meridian: Example: Work two quarry fronts at once.
identity.specialpickaxes.paradox_crucibl: Rephase the material of a selected region.
controls.specialpickaxes.paradox_crucibl: Use: arm two corners. Sneak-use when idle: choose rock family.
example.specialpickaxes.paradox_crucible: Example: Convert a selected stone wall to obsidian.
identity.specialpickaxes.interregnum: Impose kinetic stasis and local mining rules.
controls.specialpickaxes.interregnum: Aim and Use: stasis. Sneak-use: release. Mine inside to sustain it.
example.specialpickaxes.interregnum: Example: Mine while nearby hostiles remain in stasis.
identity.specialpickaxes.worldloom: Raise useful structures from your inventory.
controls.specialpickaxes.worldloom: Aim and Use: build. Offhand: material. Sneak-use: shelter/bridge.
example.specialpickaxes.worldloom: Example: Build a bridge without drawing a region.
identity.specialpickaxes.icarus: Ride a bore through a safely cleared path.
controls.specialpickaxes.icarus: Use: launch a physical bore. Sneak-use: reverse direction.
example.specialpickaxes.icarus: Example: Advance through a tunnel without noclip.
identity.specialpickaxes.hollow_axiom: Subtract the matrix, preserve the valuable core.
controls.specialpickaxes.hollow_axiom: Aim and Use: subtract geology. Sneak-use: preserve/remove ribs.
example.specialpickaxes.hollow_axiom: Example: Expose ore by removing its stone matrix.
identity.specialpickaxes.bifold_atlas: Exchange two regions without copying matter.
controls.specialpickaxes.bifold_atlas: Use: arm four corners. Sneak-left: transform. Analyze, then confirm.
identity.specialpickaxes.worldbreaker: Fracture a ring of terrain and forge its central sanctuary.
controls.specialpickaxes.worldbreaker: Sneak-use: mode. CARVE and RESTORE are direct. BREAK/REPHASE/TRANSPOSE/RECORD use regions.
example.specialpickaxes.worldbreaker: Example: Use direct cleavage now, a regional program later.
identity.specialpickaxes.chronicle: Keep and restore a geological checkpoint.
controls.specialpickaxes.chronicle: Use: arm two corners. Sneak-use when idle: record/restore.
example.specialpickaxes.chronicle: Example: Checkpoint a facade before demolition.
identity.specialpickaxes.keystone: Raise a parabolic vault where you aim.
controls.specialpickaxes.keystone: Aim at the base and Use: build the vault. Offhand: material. Sneak-use: supports.
example.specialpickaxes.keystone: Example: Create an archway from a single aimed base.
identity.specialpickaxes.tessellator: Reproduce a structure, paying for its material.
controls.specialpickaxes.tessellator: Use: arm source and target corners. Sneak-left: mirror/rotate.
example.specialpickaxes.tessellator: Example: Repeat a facade with paid bricks.
identity.specialpickaxes.aegis: Turn incoming projectiles away from danger.
controls.specialpickaxes.aegis: Aim and Use: redirect projectiles; Use again: stop. Sneak-use: reflect/shear.
example.specialpickaxes.aegis: Example: Deflect skeleton arrows without freezing mobs.
identity.specialpickaxes.lodestar: Find your way back through remembered footsteps.
controls.specialpickaxes.lodestar: Use: mark your route. Walk; Use again: retrace and consume the route. Sneak-use: forget.
example.specialpickaxes.lodestar: Example: Retrace a winding mining route, if it is still clear.
identity.specialpickaxes.seam_ripper: Peels connected material interfaces without hollowing their interiors.
controls.specialpickaxes.seam_ripper: R peels the selected seam. C changes contact/exposed mode. X peels the offhand material from the opposite side.
example.specialpickaxes.seam_ripper: Aim at stone with deepslate in your offhand to peel only the stone along their connected border.
identity.specialpickaxes.causeway: A paid path follows your steps over gaps.
controls.specialpickaxes.causeway: Use: start/stop automatic footing. Carry plain offhand material. Sneak-use stops.
example.specialpickaxes.causeway: Example: Walk over a short gap as supports appear below you.
identity.specialpickaxes.counterseal: Keep explosions from destroying nearby terrain.
controls.specialpickaxes.counterseal: Use: start/stop the moving terrain ward. Sneak-use stops. Entity damage remains.
example.specialpickaxes.counterseal: Example: Preserve a quarry facade near a TNT blast.
identity.specialpickaxes.covenant: Seal mined passages after you leave them behind.
controls.specialpickaxes.covenant: Use: start/stop sealing. Mine manually and move past holes. Offhand: filling material.
example.specialpickaxes.covenant: Example: Close a passage behind yourself with real cobblestone.
manual.specialpickaxes.heading: SHIFT — Advanced information
manual.specialpickaxes.cancel: Sneak-use cancels active work. Large jobs: Use pauses/resumes. Tool change cancels.
manual.specialpickaxes.cost: Activation wear: %s. Cooldown: %s ticks. Placement always pays real materials.
manual.specialpickaxes.enchantments: Efficiency speeds mining and jobs. Fortune scales loot (exact through 4096, logarithmic above); Silk Touch preserves blocks. Unbreaking reduces wear. Mending uses XP and discounts memory/copy activation.
manual.specialpickaxes.region_limits: Default cap: 262,144 cells; loaded chunks only. Protected/incompatible cells are skipped. No inventories or fluids.
manual.specialpickaxes.direct_limits: Bounded work, loaded chunks and protection checks. No wall traversal, unpaid blocks or inventory copying.
message.specialpickaxes.trail_marked: Route marked. Walk, then activate again to return.
limits.specialpickaxes.palimpsest: Default restoration radius 24. Default memory: 4096 records / 24 hours. Only your own inert scars.
limits.specialpickaxes.fault_choir: Default 4096 recorded blocks / 24 hours; target states must still match the score.
limits.specialpickaxes.eventide: Quarry radius up to 10; gravity field radius 8 / 600 ticks, 24 actors per tick. Allies and owned shots are excluded.
limits.specialpickaxes.meridian: Mining echoes within 8 of A. Point anchors are not selection corners; matching states only.
limits.specialpickaxes.paradox_crucible: Four inert rock families; existing permitted matter only. No loot is generated by conversion.
limits.specialpickaxes.interregnum: Field radius 8 / 600 ticks / 24 actors per tick; local mining speed x8. Release restores bounded momentum.
limits.specialpickaxes.worldloom: Preset shelter, 13 x 8 wall or 80-block bridge. Pay plain inventory blocks; no fluids or block entities.
limits.specialpickaxes.icarus: Default bore length 40, maximum 48. Stops when movement is obstructed; never crosses an uncleared wall.
limits.specialpickaxes.hollow_axiom: Default radius 10. Peels connected matrix up to six blocks from real ores; preserves ores. Optional four-block rib spacing.
limits.specialpickaxes.bifold_atlas: Disjoint volumes, matching transformed dimensions. Each pair is atomic, not the whole job.
limits.specialpickaxes.worldbreaker: Direct cut: default 48, max 64 long. Local restore radius 16. Regions are capped separately.
limits.specialpickaxes.chronicle: Default checkpoint: 4096 inert cells / 24 hours, even if the selected region is larger.
limits.specialpickaxes.keystone: 9 wide, 5 deep, rise 4; faces your direction. No replacement of occupied cells.
limits.specialpickaxes.tessellator: Only curated inert default states. No block entities, fluids, orientation/NBT copying or free materials.
limits.specialpickaxes.aegis: Default radius 8 / 400 ticks / 24 projectiles. No mob stasis, ownership changes or embedded-arrow movement.
limits.specialpickaxes.lodestar: Last 128 foot positions while held; anchor rolls forward when full. Loaded collision-clear segments, max 8 each.
limits.specialpickaxes.seam_ripper: At most 512 positions examined / 256 blocks removed per use. The seam must remain connected; it never loads chunks.
limits.specialpickaxes.causeway: Default duration 400 ticks; two candidates every 5 ticks, at the starting elevation. No climbing or fast-fall rescue.
limits.specialpickaxes.counterseal: Default radius 8 / 400 ticks. Bounded blast scan: extreme explosions may be only partially protected.
limits.specialpickaxes.covenant: Default duration 400 ticks. Up to 128 pending scars, four checked per 5 ticks; behind you and more than 2 away.
play4.palimpsest: Aim at your old excavation and activate to repair it.
warning4.palimpsest: Only your remembered scars; bring matching blocks.
play4.fault_choir: Mine a shape, then aim elsewhere and replay it. Change mode to rotate.
warning4.fault_choir: The destination rock must match the original.
play4.eventide: Aim at geology and activate a quarry field. Mining inside grants Haste II; choose the excavation direction.
warning4.eventide: Does not protect you from all damage.
play4.meridian: Activate at A and B. Mining near A echoes at B. Secondary unlinks.
warning4.meridian: Both anchors must be in the same loaded dimension.
play4.paradox_crucible: Choose the rock family, select two corners and confirm when ready.
warning4.paradox_crucible: Only ordinary inert geology; no ore creation.
play4.interregnum: Aim and activate stasis. Mining inside sustains it. Secondary releases.
warning4.interregnum: Players and allies are not frozen.
play4.worldloom: Choose shelter or bridge. Hold building material in your offhand; aim and activate.
warning4.worldloom: Needs plain building blocks; occupied cells are skipped.
play4.icarus: Look along the tunnel and activate. Reverse mode bores backwards.
warning4.icarus: Stops at obstructions; never passes through walls.
play4.hollow_axiom: Aim at the matrix around ore. Activate to remove it, optionally leaving ribs.
warning4.hollow_axiom: Leaves ores for you to harvest separately.
play4.bifold_atlas: Select source and destination corners. Choose a transform, then confirm.
warning4.bifold_atlas: The two regions must not overlap.
play4.worldbreaker: Convergence creates a sanctuary inside a shattered ring. Other modes specialize in regional work.
warning4.worldbreaker: Bring stone for the sanctuary. Protected cells remain untouched.
play4.chronicle: Record a selected area before excavation. Restore mode repairs its empty scars.
warning4.chronicle: A checkpoint is limited; restore needs matching materials.
play4.keystone: Aim at the base of your vault. Offhand selects its material.
warning4.keystone: Builds above the aimed base; cannot replace occupied blocks.
play4.tessellator: Select a blueprint and its destination, then confirm a paid copy.
warning4.tessellator: No machines or inventories; every copied block is paid.
play4.aegis: Aim and activate projectile redirection. Choose outward reflection or lateral shear.
warning4.aegis: Does not redirect player-owned shots or freeze enemies.
play4.lodestar: Activate to mark. Walk holding the relic; activate again to retrace.
warning4.lodestar: Only the last 128 footsteps; blocked segments stop the return.
play4.seam_ripper: Aim at A with B in your offhand to peel their contact seam.
warning4.seam_ripper: A and B must differ. Surface mode needs no offhand block.
play4.causeway: Activate, then walk over a gap. Offhand selects the paid footing.
warning4.causeway: Same starting elevation; no flight or fast-fall rescue.
play4.counterseal: Activate a moving ward against terrain destruction. Secondary ends it.
warning4.counterseal: Entities still take damage. Huge explosions may be only partly blocked.
play4.covenant: Activate and mine forward. Holes behind you are filled using your chosen material.
warning4.covenant: Only confirmed manual holes, behind you; never fills occupied bodies.
key.specialpickaxes.pause: Legacy pause (use R while work is running)
message.specialpickaxes.nothing_changed: Nothing changed. Check space and materials.
message.specialpickaxes.partial: Finished; some occupied or protected cells were skipped.
mining.identity.palimpsest.restore: Rebuild your actual excavation with real blocks.
mining.how.palimpsest.restore: Mine first with this pick, then point near the scar. Missing blocks are paid from inventory; occupied cells stay intact.
mining.how.fault_choir.rotate0: Mine a template with this pick. Aim at a new anchor and replay it with original orientation; only matching original material is mined.
mining.how.fault_choir.rotate90: Mine a template with this pick. Aim at a new anchor and replay it with 90° rotation; only matching original material is mined.
mining.how.fault_choir.rotate180: Mine a template with this pick. Aim at a new anchor and replay it with 180° rotation; only matching original material is mined.
mining.how.fault_choir.rotate270: Mine a template with this pick. Aim at a new anchor and replay it with 270° rotation; only matching original material is mined.
mining.how.fault_choir.mirror_x: Mine a template with this pick. Aim at a new anchor and replay it with X reflection; only matching original material is mined.
mining.how.fault_choir.mirror_z: Mine a template with this pick. Aim at a new anchor and replay it with Z reflection; only matching original material is mined.
mining.identity.eventide.gravity_in: GRAVITY WELL: four matching stone blocks trigger a forward collapse toward the anchor.
mining.how.eventide.gravity_in: Mine four consecutive blocks of the same stone variant inside the field. Fractures up to six matching blocks in a 3×3 face, prioritizing those nearer the anchor. Only natural geology counts; player-placed blocks are never included.
mining.identity.eventide.gravity_out: GRAVITY SURGE: four matching stone blocks trigger a forward collapse away from the anchor.
mining.how.eventide.gravity_out: The same 3×3 fracture, capped at six matching blocks; it prioritizes those farther from the anchor. Only natural geology counts; player-placed blocks are never included.
mining.identity.paradox_crucible.regiona: Change existing geology in a selected region.
mining.how.paradox_crucible.regional: Choose material before the second corner. Arm selection, left-click two different corners, wait for analysis, then confirm. Offhand stone, deepslate, basalt or obsidian chooses the result; empty hand means stone.
mining.identity.paradox_crucible.proximi: Change nearby geology in a sphere, without corners.
mining.how.paradox_crucible.proximity: Activate once to transform nearby natural matrix. Offhand stone, deepslate, basalt or obsidian chooses the result. No ore, loot or experience is created.
mining.identity.interregnum.stasis: Mine at extreme speed inside local stasis.
mining.how.interregnum.stasis: Aim at your worksite and activate. Mine inside the field to sustain it; nearby interruptions are slowed. Cancel releases the field.
mining.identity.worldloom.shelter: Build a paid shelter facing your direction.
mining.how.worldloom.shelter: Hold a supported building block in your offhand. Aim at the base; the preview follows your facing. Activate to place the shelter in sequence, consuming inventory blocks.
mining.identity.worldloom.bridge: Build a paid bridge facing your direction.
mining.how.worldloom.bridge: Hold a supported building block in your offhand. Aim at the base; the preview follows your facing. Activate to place the bridge in sequence, consuming inventory blocks.
mining.identity.worldloom.wall: Build a paid wall facing your direction.
mining.how.worldloom.wall: Hold a supported building block in your offhand. Aim at the base; the preview follows your facing. Activate to place the wall in sequence, consuming inventory blocks.
mining.identity.icarus.forward: ANGELIC BORE: safe forward travel through a 3×3 tunnel.
mining.how.icarus.forward: Activate to bore safely in scheduled slices. End Rod and enchant particles trace the route. Use X for Icarian Lift.
mining.identity.icarus.reverse: Drill and advance backward through safe sections.
mining.how.icarus.reverse: Activate once. The bore runs backward along your view axis, clearing each section before moving you. Any barrier stops the route.
mining.identity.worldbreaker.carve: CARVE: drive a long rounded mining tunnel.
mining.how.worldbreaker.carve: Aim at the cutting face. Activate once to excavate successive rounded sections along your view axis.
mining.identity.worldbreaker.fracture: FRACTURE: split a widening mining fan.
mining.how.worldbreaker.fracture: Aim and activate. A low fan widens as the cut advances, rather than removing a cuboid.
mining.identity.worldbreaker.cleave: CLEAVE: cut a smooth oval face.
mining.how.worldbreaker.cleave: Aim and activate to carve a broad, rounded oval opening, not a sharp diamond. The scheduler checks each slice and stops at barriers.
mining.identity.worldbreaker.core_drill: CORE DRILL: sink a deep vertical shaft.
mining.how.worldbreaker.core_drill: Activate to drill vertically below your feet. Slow Falling and fall-damage protection last until it ends; the shaft stops at the first barrier.
mining.identity.worldbreaker.world_shatt: WORLD SHATTER: excavate a vast terraced wedge.
mining.how.worldbreaker.world_shatter: Aim and activate once. Successive sections widen and deepen into a large directional excavation. Real harvesting is spread across ticks, not one server-freezing explosion.
mining.limits: Never edits bedrock, fluids, machines or protected blocks. Directional routes stop at barriers. Pause or cancel with your configured keys.
message.specialpickaxes.drop_pause: Paused for drop congestion. Collect drops, then resume.
combat.specialpickaxes.palimpsest: On hit: Regeneration II and Absorption II for 10s/8s.
combat.specialpickaxes.fault_choir: On hit: Weakness III for 8s and Slowness II for 5s.
combat.specialpickaxes.paradox_crucible: On hit: ignite the target for 8s.
combat.specialpickaxes.interregnum: On hit: Slowness V for 8s and Weakness II for 5s.
combat.specialpickaxes.worldloom: On hit: Absorption IV for 12s and Resistance I for 5s.
combat.specialpickaxes.icarus: On hit: Slow Falling for 10s, Jump Boost II for 8s and Speed II for 6s.
combat.specialpickaxes.hollow_axiom: On hit: Glowing for 10s and Weakness II for 5s.
mining.identity.interregnum.domain: DOMAIN: a marked 16×16 Stasis field that supports nearby allies.
mining.how.interregnum.domain: Aim at a worksite and activate. The visible border marks the domain. Inside it, you gain mining speed ×8, Regeneration V, food restoration and Night Vision; allies gain healing, Haste, food and Night Vision.
mining.how.interregnum.aura: Activate without aiming at a block. The small aura follows only you and grants ×8 mining speed, Night Vision and one food point every five seconds. It does not freeze mobs.
mining.identity.worldloom.quarry: ROOTWAKE: a branching root tunnel through natural stone.
mining.how.worldloom.quarry: Aim at natural geology and activate. Opens a 3×3 tunnel up to 24 blocks forward, with side roots branching every six blocks. Ores, fluids, player-placed blocks, machines and protected cells stay safe.
mining.identity.palimpsest.vein: VEIN ECHO: harvest the connected ore vein.
mining.how.palimpsest.vein: Aim at an exposed ore and activate. It searches a 12-block radius and mines up to 256 connected blocks by default, respecting Fortune, protections and normal drops.
mining.how.fault_choir.forward: Aim forward and activate. The tunnel follows your view; it never flips behind you or replays distant blocks.
message.specialpickaxes.gravity_marked: Gravity field anchored. Mine inside it to charge a collapse.
mining.how.paradox_crucible.stone: Select two corners, wait for analysis and confirm. Only natural geology in the region changes to Stone.
mining.how.paradox_crucible.deepslate: Select two corners, wait for analysis and confirm. Only natural geology in the region changes to Deepslate.
mining.how.paradox_crucible.granite: Select two corners, wait for analysis and confirm. Only natural geology in the region changes to Granite.
mining.how.paradox_crucible.diorite: Select two corners, wait for analysis and confirm. Only natural geology in the region changes to Diorite.
mining.how.paradox_crucible.andesite: Select two corners, wait for analysis and confirm. Only natural geology in the region changes to Andesite.
mining.how.paradox_crucible.dirt: Select two corners, wait for analysis and confirm. Only natural geology in the region changes to Dirt.
mining.how.paradox_crucible.basalt: Select two corners, wait for analysis and confirm. Only natural geology in the region changes to Basalt.
mining.how.paradox_crucible.obsidian: Select two corners, wait for analysis and confirm. Only natural geology in the region changes to Obsidian.
mining.how.icarus.wide: The same safe forward route with a 5×5 cross-section. It never reverses and will not enter water, lava or modded fluids.
mining.identity.worldbreaker.region_brea: REGION BREAK: mine a selected cuboid safely.
mining.how.worldbreaker.region_break: Choose this mode, select two corners, wait for analysis and confirm. Only blocks your pick can harvest are mined; fluids, bedrock, containers, claims and other barriers stay intact.
message.specialpickaxes.survey: Resonance found %s ore blocks in range.
message.specialpickaxes.survey_empty: No ores found in the surveyed area.
tooltip.specialpickaxes.exodium: Drills a 13×9 safe gallery up to 48 blocks ahead.
tooltip.specialpickaxes.secondary.exodiu: X: aim at natural geology to drill a 5×5 shaft up to 32 blocks downward. Placed blocks and barriers stop it.
mining.how.exodium.starfall: Opens a 13×9 gallery up to 48 blocks ahead. Work is spread across ticks and stops at any barrier.
tooltip.specialpickaxes.iridium: Mines loaded vanilla and modded ores in a 29×15×29 ellipsoid, nearest first. Ore drops glow.
tooltip.specialpickaxes.secondary.iridiu: Aim at the center and activate. It mines ores as it reaches them; it skips unloaded chunks, fluids, containers and protected areas.
mining.how.iridium.orefall: Mines loaded, harvestable ores in a 29×15×29 ellipsoid around your target, nearest positions first. Each ore is mined as soon as it is found, up to the server work limit. Drops from ores mined with this pick glow; X recalls them. It never loads chunks or crosses protections.
tooltip.specialpickaxes.hellspec: Excavates a five-petal bloom through natural geology and ores; preserves placed blocks and protected cells.
tooltip.specialpickaxes.secondary.hellsp: X: aim at any lava to harden up to 64 connected source or flowing blocks into obsidian. Placed and protected blocks stay safe.
mining.how.hellspec.hellforge: Aim at a block of natural geology or ore and activate. The marked core and four petals excavate over time; the pick preserves player-placed blocks, machines, and protected cells.
message.specialpickaxes.orefall_empty: No harvestable ores found in range.
message.specialpickaxes.curio_cooldown: That Curios skill is still recharging.

screen.specialpickaxes.curios_passive: In the Curios Pickaxe slot, this item grants only the passive effects listed above. Hold it to use R and X.

alternate.detail.specialpickaxes.palimps: 6-block pulse: knocks back up to 24 nearby hostile mobs.
alternate.detail.specialpickaxes.fault_c: Stops current movement and applies Slowness III to up to four grounded hostiles within 6 blocks for 2 s. No damage; respects allies, protections, and server PvP rules.
alternate.detail.specialpickaxes.eventid: Pulls up to 64 owned or unowned drops within 16 blocks.
alternate.detail.specialpickaxes.paradox: Deflects up to 32 hostile projectiles within 10 blocks.
alternate.detail.specialpickaxes.interre: In Domain mode, aim up to 32 blocks away to move the field while preserving its remaining time. In Aura mode, freezes up to 24 nearby hostile monsters and projectiles for 2 s.
alternate.detail.specialpickaxes.worldlo: Press X to root up to 16 hostile mobs or PvP-valid players within 10 blocks around you. Vine particles bind their feet for 2.5 s; no aiming is needed.
alternate.detail.specialpickaxes.icarus: Press X to mine a one-block-wide, two-block-high shaft and rise through it one block at a time. It stops at the surface, a barrier, or the world height limit (up to 384 blocks); player-placed blocks are preserved.
alternate.detail.specialpickaxes.hollow_: Press X to repel and mark up to 24 hostile mobs or PvP-valid players within 8 blocks, and deflect up to 24 hostile projectiles. It still works against projectiles when no enemy is nearby.
alternate.detail.specialpickaxes.worldbr: Uses the X skill of the pick chosen in the I Manual.
alternate.detail.specialpickaxes.exodium: Aim at natural geology and press X. The pick drills a 5×5 shaft up to 32 blocks downward, mining ores and stopping at player-placed blocks, fluids, or barriers.
alternate.detail.specialpickaxes.iridium: Glows and pulls up to 96 recent drops from your Iridium-mined ores within 24 blocks.
alternate.detail.specialpickaxes.hellspe: Aim at a lava source or flow and press X. Seals up to 64 connected lava blocks within 4 blocks of the hit into obsidian. Placed blocks, machines and protected cells stay safe.

mining.identity.seam_ripper.contact: Peel the connected geological boundary of targeted material A where it touches offhand material B.
